capabilities: Render vector maps with Mapbox styles, glyphs, and tiles
Resolve search terms to place suggestions and coordinates
Build routes between waypoints and reachability isochrones
Snap recorded tracks to the road or path network
Read elevation and load 3D terrain DEM tiles
disambiguation: Not a standalone map plugin; it is a provider that plugs into the Places plugin.
extras: README only lists network requests and code dependencies; no usage instructions. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Map provider for Places using Mapbox
problem: Places needs a map rendering backend, and this supplies a Mapbox-based one with routing, search, and terrain features beyond basic tile display.

relations.evidence: Map provider for Places using Mapbox

summary: Mapbox-based map provider for the Places plugin that renders vector maps and adds POI search, directions, isochrones, elevation, and track snapping.
